We stayed for just one night (luckily), as we needed a bed for a night before we left for the airport.
The room was really dirty and even the bed sheet was stained. Also, there was a very uncomfortable smell in the room. I'm not sure if it was mold or the AC.
I guess at this rate you can't expect much more.
At least the service was good. We got a private phone number for the case of any issues and could reach the person at 5am in the morning, when we had to go to the airport.
